## What changed

Describe the smallest reviewable change.

## Why

Link the issue or explain the problem and intended outcome.

## Tests

List the commands and manual workflows you ran.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible changes, using synthetic data. Otherwise write “Not applicable.”

## Breaking changes

Describe API, data, configuration, or behavior changes. Otherwise write “None.”

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run verify` or explained a check I could not run.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated relevant user or developer documentation.
- [ ] I used only synthetic, authorized, or safely redistributable fixtures.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, authentication state, Pro-only code, or private endpoints.
- [ ] My change does not bypass CAPTCHA, authentication, access controls, rate limits, or platform safeguards.
- [ ] I considered Electron IPC, file import, local storage, export, and compatibility risks where relevant.
